fields.breadcrumb-text-2: How can you grow your bakery?
fields.title-post: How can you grow your bakery?
fields.rt-blog-html:
Growing a bakery is no longer solely about the quality of the bread; today, it requires developing a comprehensive growth strategy. In a competitive market with over 33,000 bakeries in France, success depends on a holistic approach that combines business strategy, digitalization, and cost control.

Using the right tools to structure your growth is therefore essential.

‍

How can you increase your bakery's revenue?

Increasing a bakery’s revenue depends on several complementary strategies: attracting more customers, increasing the frequency of their visits, and optimizing each checkout transaction.

Diversify your product lineup to attract new customers

Diversifying your bakery offerings allows you to expand your customer base. In addition to traditional products, offering snacks, beverages, or vegetarian options helps you meet changing consumer habits.

According to FranceNum, offering fast food can increase revenue by 20 to 30 percent. This strategy is part of an effort to adapt to current lifestyles, particularly on-the-go dining.

Expand your sales channels to maximize your business potential

Limiting yourself to physical retail locations hinders growth. Click-and-collect, delivery, and online ordering are ways to increase revenue without increasing resources. 

These channels also make it possible to reach a wider customer base, particularly busy professionals.

👉 Learn more: How to set up click-and-collect at your bakery

Maximize the average order value through upselling and merchandising

Increasing the average basket size is a strategy that is often underutilized. Suggestions at the checkout, lunch specials, or product promotions directly influence purchasing decisions.

Well-curated merchandise, combined with streamlined order processing, quickly improves performance.

👉 Learn more: Taking orders at a bakery: minimizing errors

‍

How can you digitize your bakery to improve operational efficiency?

Digitalization streamlines operations and improves day-to-day management. It saves time, enables better performance management, and enhances the customer experience.

Choose the right POS software to manage your business in real time

Point-of-sale software is no longer limited to processing payments. It centralizes sales, revenue, performance metrics, and team management.

A comprehensive ecosystem provides a holistic view and facilitates decision-making.

👉 Learn more: Which POS software should you choose for your bakery?

Automate inventory management to reduce losses and waste

Inefficient inventory management leads to significant losses, particularly with fresh produce.

A digital system updates inventory in real time. You can adjust production levels, reduce waste, and improve your profit margin.

Implement click-and-collect to improve the customer experience

Click-and-collect is gradually becoming the norm in bakeries. Easy to integrate into an existing website, it reduces wait times and simplifies the ordering process.

This service enhances the customer experience and drives additional sales, while reducing wait times.

How can you maximize profitability and control your costs?

Growing a bakery also requires careful management. Profitability depends directly on effective cost and performance management.

Manage your costs to improve your operating margin

Raw materials account for a significant portion of expenses. Careful management of purchasing and volumes remains essential.

According to Bpifrance, the net margin for an artisanal bakery ranges from 5% to 10%. Even a slight improvement can therefore have a significant impact on overall profitability.

👉 Learn more: Financing a Bakery Startup: A Comprehensive Guide for 2026

Track your key performance indicators (KPIs) to make the right decisions

Tracking KPIs allows you to continuously adjust your strategy. Metrics such as revenue, average order value, conversion rate, and inventory turnover provide a clear picture of your business.

Analyzing this data makes it possible to quickly identify areas for improvement.

Streamline payments to speed up checkout transactions

Fast checkout improves the customer experience and increases your ability to serve more customers during peak hours.

Integrating a digital payment system that’s connected to your ecosystem simplifies your teams’ work and reduces errors.

“Digitizing our retail locations is, above all, a way to save time when taking orders. And saving time means satisfied customers.” Sara, Co-founder of Makai

‍

Paris Baguette: What Lessons Can You Learn to Grow Your Bakery?

Drawing inspiration from successful models helps identify concrete growth drivers. Paris Baguette, a South Korean chain founded in 1988, has more than 4,000 locations worldwide.

Paris Baguette's business model: franchising and standardization

Paris Baguette operates on the basis of a structured franchise model and standardized processes. Each store follows consistent methods in production, sales, and management.

This structure ensures consistent quality and facilitates the expansion of the network.

👉 Learn more: Bakery franchises: how to manage them effectively in 2026

Key success factors for your institution

The brand's success is based on a wide range of products, extensive digitalization, and an optimized customer experience.

Modern spaces and on-site dining, similar to the café-bakery model, help increase average spending and foot traffic.

Adapting these strategies to the context of an independent bakery

These strategies remain within reach for independent bakeries. Structuring their product offerings, digitizing their tools, and optimizing the customer experience are concrete ways to achieve this.

The goal is to draw on best practices to build sustainable growth tailored to the local market.

‍

Growing a bakery depends on striking a balance between business strategy, digitalization, and sound management. Attracting customers, increasing the average transaction value, and controlling costs lead to long-term improvements in profitability.

The example of Paris Baguette shows that effective growth relies on structured processes and an optimized customer experience. For a business of your size, integrating a high-performance digital ecosystem is a key driver for accelerating your growth.
